sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: Frankenjura is a German limestone sport-climbing region with many small forest crags.

sections.heading: History and context
warnings: No sourced history and context content found for this pass.

sections.heading: Rock and climbing character
sections.body: The external source supports limestone; the legacy packet supports short, powerful, pocketed and crimpy sport routes in forest settings.

sections.heading: Who it suits
sections.body: The legacy packet says the area has routes from easy to hard, but also emphasizes demanding bouldery climbing.

sections.heading: Grades and difficulty
sections.body: Legacy evidence gives almost 8,000 climbs in about 1,000 smaller crags and “all grades”; no more precise grade span was assigned.

sections.heading: Season and conditions
sections.body: The legacy packet supports early spring to late autumn, with shade in summer and shelter considerations in spring/autumn.
